question: If the sides of a rectangle, whose area is 154 cm², differ by 3 cm, then find the length (in cm) of the longer side.
solution:
**Given:**

Area = 154 cm²

L(Length) - B(Breadth) = 3 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of Rectangle = L × B

**Calculation:**

L - B = 3 cm (Given)

⇒ L = B + 3

⇒ 154 = B × (B + 3)

⇒ B² + 3B - 154 = 0

⇒ B² + 14B - 11B - 154 = 0

⇒ B(B + 14) - 11(B + 14) = 0

⇒ (B + 14) (B - 11) = 0

⇒ B = -14 ,11(Correct value)

⇒ L = 11 + 3 

⇒ L = 14 cm

∴ The correct answer is **14 **cm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points:__**1. Here in the above solution we took length as the longer side.

2. Similarly, Breadth can also be considered as a longer side.

3. In both cases the answer will be the same.
